$schema_note: Ground truth for the SAU-532 Phase-1 corpus (corpus/generate.py). Same field shape as hard_columns.json so core/gate.py scores it identically. Two groups: (1) the SEVEN trap types Phase 0 never seeded — BYTEA, UUID, INTERVAL, MONEY, XML, TIME, SMALLINT — planted as hand-authored literals in VALUES-only tables so bullet 0 can audit that each landed; (2) known Phase-0 categories planted alongside so bullet 4's ablation still has traps to inject in this corpus. Expected targets were written from the type's documented semantics before any run, not from what the mapper happens to emit — a column the mapper cannot recognize is supposed to FAIL here; that is the finding, not a calibration error.

hard_columns.trap: UUID — canonical 8-4-4-4-12 lowercase hex text; upper-case input is normalized by the type ('FFFFFFFF-…' → 'ffffffff-…'); must never be coerced to NUMBER or truncated
hard_columns.assert: 36-char canonical text preserved; joins on it survive

hard_columns.trap: BYTEA — variable-length raw bytes; hex on the wire ('\x…'); a VARCHAR target stores the hex *text* and doubles size, a fixed BINARY(8) truncates
hard_columns.assert: byte identity preserved incl. empty value and embedded NUL

hard_columns.trap: INTERVAL — no native Snowflake type; '1 year 2 months' has no fixed second count, so coercing to a number of seconds is lossy; negative intervals exist
hard_columns.assert: postgres interval text preserved verbatim, never parsed to a number

hard_columns.trap: TIME — a time-of-day with µs fraction and no date; mapping to TIMESTAMP invents a date, mapping to VARCHAR loses the type
hard_columns.assert: wall-clock time incl. fraction preserved; 23:59:59.999999 does not roll over

hard_columns.trap: MONEY — the wire form is LOCALE-FORMATTED text ('$1,234.56', '-$99,999.99'); ::text is not parseable as a number, and the value has fixed scale 2 under lc_monetary=en_US — extraction must go through ::numeric
hard_columns.assert: exact decimal value preserved, sign and thousands intact

hard_columns.trap: XML — no equality operator (profiler min/max/distinct all fail), no native target; PARSE_XML into VARIANT re-serializes (entity refs, attribute order), so only the text is lossless
hard_columns.assert: document text preserved verbatim incl. entity references

hard_columns.trap: SMALLINT — int2 range incl. -32768 and 32767; a BOOLEAN or TINYINT guess from the small domain is wrong
fixed-width hex with leading zeros; must stay textual identity
high-precision currency — FLOAT loses the 4th decimal (0.0001)
timestamp WITHOUT time zone — TIMESTAMP_TZ invents an offset
fixed-width PII with leading zeros ('0042','0007') — NUMBER drops them
numeric-looking legacy text ('000123', '4,50', '1e5') — must NOT be parsed
narrow float — 3.14159274 is the float4 nearest to π; identity is approximate and must be flagged lossy
array → ARRAY incl. the empty array and NULL, never a flattened string
precision-sensitive rate — 0.088750 must not become 0.08875 in FLOAT
